functions.name: GetMeshDescriptionCopy
functions.docs: Get a copy of the MeshDescription available through this Provider.

functions.name: GetAvailableLODs
functions.docs:
For providers that have LODs (i.e. if SupportsLODs returns true), returns an array of all available LODs. Otherwise, returns an array with just the Default LOD.
@param bSkipAutoGenerated	Skip auto-generated LODs, which have no associated source Mesh Description

functions.name: GetMeshDescriptionLOD
functions.docs: For providers that have LODs (i.e. if SupportsLODs returns true), returns the LOD that GetMeshDescription/etc will return. Otherwise, returns Default LOD.

functions.name: SupportsLODs
functions.docs: @return true if the provider is able to provide different Mesh Descriptions for different requested LODs.  If so, GetAvailableLODs() will return the available LODs.

functions.name: GetPolygonGroupToMaterialIndexMap
functions.docs: @return a mapping from section ID to material ID. If empty, an identity mapping is assumed.
